title: The jar isn't too tight. You're doing it wrong 🫙
caption:
Open any stuck jar in 3 seconds. No muscles needed 🫙💪

sources: Vacuum sealing: cooling contents lower the internal pressure, so atmospheric pressure holds the lid (USDA / National Center for Home Food Preservation, canning basics)
Thermal expansion: metal expands more than glass when heated (coefficients of linear expansion; e.g. Engineering Toolbox)
